content.title: CSGS Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion and Revenue Diversification Remain Central Themes
content.summary: Customer experience software company CSG Systems (NASDAQ:CSGS) reported Q2 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 2.3% year on year to $297.1 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.23 billion at the midpoint came in 9.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.16 per share was 10.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
